title: Split Windows (:split, :vsplit)
instruction_text:
View multiple files side-by-side!

':vsplit' or ':vsp' = vertical split (side-by-side)
'Ctrl+w w' = switch between split windows
'Ctrl+w q' = close current split window

Your task: section1.txt has a SECRET CODE.
You need to copy it to section2.txt (replace REPLACE_ME).

Steps:
1. Type ':vsplit section2.txt' (or ':vsp section2.txt')
2. Both files now visible side-by-side!
3. Look at section1.txt to see the SECRET CODE
4. Switch to section2.txt (Ctrl+w w)
5. Navigate to 'REPLACE_ME'
6. Press 'cw' and type the SECRET CODE you see
7. Press ESC, then :wq

This is WHY splits are useful - reference while editing!
